Create a Quantitative Imaging DICOM SR TID 1500 Measurement Report

Source: R/sr-tid1500.R
dicom_sr_tid1500.Rd

Computes volumetric and morphologic quantitative imaging biomarkers (volume in cubic millimeters and cubic centimeters, RECIST longest in-plane diameter in millimeters, and mean, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum voxel intensity) for each segment in a dicom_seg object against a reference dicom_volume, and optionally writes a DICOM Structured Report following TID 1500 (Measurement Report).

Usage

dicom_sr_tid1500(
  vol,
  seg,
  out_path = NULL,
  patient_name = "ANONYMOUS",
  patient_id = "ANON001",
  study_uid = NULL,
  title = "Imaging Measurement Report"
)

Arguments

vol

Reference dicom_volume object containing image intensities.

seg

A dicom_seg segmentation object aligned with vol.

out_path

Optional output .dcm file path. If provided, writes a DICOM Comprehensive 3D SR (1.2.840.10008.5.1.4.1.1.88.34) Part 10 file.

patient_name

Optional PatientName (0010,0010). Defaults to "ANONYMOUS".

patient_id

Optional PatientID (0010,0020). Defaults to "ANON001".

study_uid

Optional StudyInstanceUID (0020,000D). Defaults to vol$uids$study_instance_uid or a newly generated UID.

title

Report title (SeriesDescription). Default is "Imaging Measurement Report".

Value

An S3 object of class "dicom_sr_tid1500" containing:

summary

A tibble with one row per ROI (segment_id, label, volume_mm3, volume_cm3, recist_diameter_mm, mean_intensity, sd_intensity, min_intensity, max_intensity, units).

measurements

A tidy long-format tibble of all TID 1500 NUM measurement items.

content_tree

Nested list representation of the DICOM ContentSequence (0040,A730) tree.

file

Normalized path to out_path if written, otherwise NULL.

Examples

synth <- dicom_synthesize(modality = "CT", dims = c(32L, 32L, 4L))
vol <- read_dicom_volume(synth[["out_dir"]])
m <- array(0L, dim = c(32L, 32L, 4L))
m[10:19, 10:19, 2:3] <- 1L
seg <- dicom_seg(m, vol, tibble::tibble(segment_id = 1L, label = "Lesion_1"))
sr <- dicom_sr_tid1500(vol, seg)
sr$summary
#> # A tibble: 1 × 10
#>   segment_id label    volume_mm3 volume_cm3 recist_diameter_mm mean_intensity
#>        <int> <chr>         <dbl>      <dbl>              <dbl>          <dbl>
#> 1          1 Lesion_1        500        0.5               13.7           61.9
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: sd_intensity <dbl>, min_intensity <dbl>,
#> #   max_intensity <dbl>, units <chr>
